# Try These Examples

Send each example in its own chat after setting up the instructions. For the rewrite example, send both messages in order in the same chat.

| Input | What to look for |
| --- | --- |
| `I need your help.` | Refined English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese. Keep I as the speaker. |
| `Tôi đã gửi email hôm qua.` | The three default sections; retain “I,” sending the email and yesterday. |
| `予約はまだ確認されていません。` | English Translation only: The reservation has not been confirmed yet. |
| `客人尚未支付费用。` | English Translation only: The guest has not paid the fee yet. |
| `Le train est en retard.` | English Translation only: The train is late. |
| `They are scaming us.` | Main English retains “They are scamming us.” Do not accept a softer version that adds doubt. |
| 1. `Please check the room.` 2. `Make it more polite.` | Regenerate the three sections; only the politeness changes. |
